1. **`starlette/endpoints.py`**: Added "QUERY" to the `_allowed_methods` tuple in `HTTPEndpoint.__init__`, so class-based endpoints with `async def query(self, request)` methods are properly recognized and routed. QUERY also appears in the `Allow` header alongside other standard methods.
